david-esper.name: David Esper
david-esper.role: Lead editor and head of research, growth software
david-esper.short_bio: David Esper leads research and editorial review at InsightToolz, covering the SEO, content, outreach, CRM, automation and analytics software that agencies and lean marketing teams run on. He researches each guide from vendors' official pricing pages, documentation and help centers, and updates it when plans or limits change.
long_bio: David Esper is the lead editor and head of research at InsightToolz. He covers the software behind modern growth teams: SEO platforms, AI writing tools, email and cold-outreach software, CRMs, marketing automation, analytics, and the operations tools agencies use to deliver client work.

Research comes first in every guide he signs off. He works from primary sources, meaning each vendor's own pricing page, documentation, help center and release notes. He records where every price, plan limit and feature claim came from and when it was checked, and he leaves a figure out rather than guess when official pages disagree.

That research feeds the buying decision rather than a feature tour. Each guide explains who a tool suits, what it really costs once seats, contacts or usage are counted, and where it falls short, so a busy team can shortlist with confidence.
David holds every page to the same editorial rules. Prices are linked and dated, nothing is described as tested unless it was, and no vendor can pay for inclusion or placement.
